definitions.full: H6796. tsanin [ צָנִין ] noun [masculine] thorn, prick ; — plural צְנִּינִּם Num 33:55 (P; || שִׂכִּים ), צְנִנִים Josh 23:13 (D; both figurative). II. צנן (√ of following; Late Hebrew צָנַן be cold , so Jewish-Aramaic צְנַן ; צִינְתָא ᵑ7 cold ).
